title: Who is misrepresenting Hindutva? | BJP's Tejasvi Surya, BSP MP Danish Ali | Times Now Summit 2020
description: BJP MP Tejasvi Surya, BSP MP Danish Ali, and Former MP from CPM MB Rajesh engage in a panel discussion on the topic ‘Who is misrepresenting Hindutva’ at the Times Now Summit 2020. 'Hindutva cannot be dominating because it is the victim of aggression.' says Tejavi Surya. According to Savarkar, Hindutva & Hinduism are not the same. Hinduism is a belief. says. former CPM MP MB Rajesh. Tune in to know more! | #TimesNowSummit  Across 2 days, over 25+ sessions, we will see leading voices from India’s political, economic and business landscape, discuss issues of national priority. From economic progress, education, welfare, urban-rural divide, defence, sports and much more, this will be India’s seminal leadership forum for holistic development.  Leading figures include Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi; Union Home Minister, Amit Shah; Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman; Minster for Railways, Piyush Goyal; Minister of Textiles, Smriti Irani amongst others have confirmed their attendance for the event.  TIMES NOW Summit is built with a purpose to accelerate the ‘New India’ vision by taking a holistic approach in defining a constructive action plan for India. Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi will deliver the keynote address at the summit, defining the action plan for India’s robust growth.
